children.text:
How well does AI
build Arabic?
children.name: Headline

children.text: Every month, free AI models build five Arabic screens on their own, then again with Dualkit. dualkit check scores every build against 20 rules.

children.text: A payment summary, a one-time code, an address form, a profile and an order history. Every prompt is public.
children.name: Body

children.text: Each model builds each screen three times on its own, then three times with the Dualkit skills loaded. The middle run counts.
children.name: Body

children.text: The same 20 rules you can run with npx dualkit check. A build that leaves out a part the prompt asked for scores 0.
children.name: Body

children.text: Free models only, run once a month. A model that fails shows as didn’t run, never as a guess.
